explain.en: Python packages cached by uv. Nothing of yours is lost, but large re-downloads follow and offline installs fail until then. uv's docs say not to edit this cache by hand, so Hoardless only shows uv's own command.
explain.zh: uv 缓存的 Python 包。不会丢你的东西，但之后要大量重新下载，重新下载完之前离线安装会失败。uv 官方说不要手动改这个缓存，所以这里只给出 uv 自带的清理命令。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: ~/.cache/uv 7.0G. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: ~/Library/Caches/uv is the pre-0.3.0 location and still wins over XDG_CACHE_HOME if it exists (cli.rs); both default paths are always scanned, so it is never hidden. Files are linked into venvs, so du overstates what a clean frees.
